scope: Manifest production modules; external roots from listed selfhost/docs text files excluding build/dist/.bootstrap/node_modules/.git. Historical tool references conservatively retained. No builds or candidate rewrites.
method: Top-level declaration blocks include @unsafe and trailing blanks up to next unindented item/comment. Quote/comment-masked production identifier graph, all external text identifiers as roots; conservative lexical evidence, not a full Bend resolver. Helper gross is not savings: body retained, extra locals and all caller edits must be charged. External-root count is nonempty observed references (zero-entry defaultdict lookups are excluded). Helper SCC membership is separated: a solely called indirect-recursive continuation may be inlinable, but is not treated as a nonrecursive helper. Helper law savings overlap any declaration-signature rewrite and must not be counted twice.
